body:
## What to build

Preserve an External error's class, diagnostic, and cause when a Margin summary has already buffered an earlier warning and encounters a later ordinary error. Under warn = 2, package-owned warning replay must not replace that already-raised error with a warning-derived error that loses its cause.

## Reproduction and observed behavior

Use a valid local two-row data frame grouped by a/b, with values 2/5 and a rollup. A user summary function warns on each length-one detailed group and returns its sum; on the length-two Grand total group it raises an error whose class includes late_failure and whose diagnostic is “late failure”. No namespace tracing or cleanup mock is needed.

With warn = 1, the escaping dplyr error retained late_failure as its parent. With warn = 2, after the later branch raised its error, the package exit handler replayed a buffered warning through real warning signaling: the escaping condition became a warning-derived simpleError with no parent. Disabling only the earlier warning source preserved the late_failure cause even at warn = 2. Three minimum reproductions agreed. The input was unchanged and a later normal summary succeeded.

This violated the public Errors and warnings contract and ADRs 0015/0021, which preserve External error class, diagnostic, and cause. R's warnings-as-errors behavior explained the runtime mechanism; package-owned replay during unwind created the loss. This differs from the resolved SQL audit warning issue #655: it was a local summary replay problem with the later original error already raised. The [dated investigation and archived observations](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/7a895ebd5a3eb28e04d6268dcc432fbc5d5912f5/investigation/exception-safety-recovery-2026-09-30.md) contains minimum and normal controls and the observed condition chains.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add a public local-summary regression with a warning in an earlier successful grouping-set branch and an ordinary error in a later branch. Prove that the later error was reached before replay.
- [ ] At warn = 2, retain the later ordinary error's diagnostic and original cause/class through the package's supported External-condition context rewriting. Do not replace it with an unrelated warning-derived simpleError lacking that cause.
- [ ] Retain warn = 1 reporting, distinct/repeated warning handling, and the established warning-as-error outcome when no later ordinary error is pending. Do not solve the regression by suppressing all warnings.
- [ ] Compare with a control disabling only the warning source and a healthy sum result of 2/5/7; verify input preservation and a normal same-session call after removing the fault source, without resetting the namespace or diagnostic state.
- [ ] Use real warning signaling and real exit cleanup. Keep undecided interrupt precedence outside the ordinary-error acceptance and complete applicable package/review gates.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
title: Preserve the later External error when buffered warnings are replayed with warn = 2
